ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Business - New Customer"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Business - Cross-Sell") ), ISCHANGED(StageName), CASE( TEXT(StageName), "Lead Qualification", 1, "Discovery", 2, "SE Technical Review", 3, "Proposal", 4, "RFP", 5, "Award", 6, "Scoping", 7, "Contract", 8, "Closed Won", 9, 0 ) > 6, CASE( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)), "Lead Qualification", 1, "Discovery", 2, "SE Technical Review", 3, "Proposal", 4, "RFP", 5, "Award", 6, "Scoping", 7, "Contract", 8, "Closed Won", 9, 0 ) <= 6, OR( ISBLANK(Actual_Award_Date__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Award_Type__c)), ISBLANK(SOW_Execution_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete Award before advancing: Award Date, Award Type, and SOW Exectution Date are required.
